env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run ./lmod
stdout '^go=0 logos=7$'

-- m/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./lmod
	./gmod
)
-- m/lmod/go.mod --
module example.com/lmod

go 1.27
-- m/gmod/go.mod --
module example.com/gmod

go 1.27
-- m/lmod/cfg/cfg.lgo --
package cfg

type C struct {
	N int = 7
}
-- m/lmod/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/lmod/cfg"
	"example.com/gmod/gouse"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Printf("go=%d logos=%d\n", gouse.Value(), cfg.C{}.N)
}
-- m/gmod/gouse/value.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package gouse

import "example.com/lmod/cfg"

func Value() int {
	return cfg.C{}.N
}
